# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This sales training knowledge base is distilled directly from genuine sales, negotiation, and quotation calls conducted by BSC (Bharat Steel Group / Bharat Steel Chennai Private Limited). The corpus captures direct business-to-business (B2B) communications between sales coordinators (primarily Varsha and the central sales desk) and end-users, fabricators, infrastructure contractors, and steel traders across Tamil Nadu and neighboring South Indian regions (Chennai, Salem, Hosur, Pudukkottai, Mettur, Pondicherry, Thoothukudi).

Internal operations noise (such as driver route navigation, yard attendance, crane maintenance, and domestic side-conversations) has been filtered out to isolate pure sales intelligence: product sizing, brand ladders, price structures, customer objections, operational boundaries, and desk closing techniques.

---

## Products & brand ladder

BSC operates primarily as a primary steel distributor and stockist with de-coiling/CTL (Cut-to-Length) shearing machinery at its Vichur (Ponneri Taluk, Chennai) godown and Salem stock point.

```
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                 BRAND LADDER                                       |
+====================================================================================+
| Primary / PSU Mills     | SAIL, RINL (Vizag / VSP), NMDC (National Mineral         |
|                         | Development Corp - ex-SAIL group), JSW                   |
+-------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Secondary / Re-Rolling  | Commercial re-rolling mills (used strictly for angles     |
|                         | <50 mm, small channels, or when primary rolling is dead)  |
+-------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Sister Concern Routing  | Crayon Roofing & Structures (decking sheets & roofing)   |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### 1. MS / HR Plates & Sheets
* **Thickness Range:** 3 mm, 4 mm, 4.8 mm, 5 mm, 5.8 mm, 6 mm, 8 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 14 mm, 16 mm, 20 mm, 25 mm, 30 mm, 32 mm, up to 80 mm (heavy plates).
* **Grades Handled:**
  * **IS 2062 E250 BR** (Standard commercial/structural grade).
  * **IS 2062 E350 BR** (High-yield structural grade).
  * **E450** (High tensile, available on selective inquiries).
  * *Strict Policy:* **E350 Class C (E350C)** is **not dealt**. Sales team pitches **E350 BR** as the certified substitute.
* **Standard Plate Dimensions:**
  * Standard Widths: 1250 mm, 1500 mm, 2000 mm, 2500 mm (for heavy plates >25 mm).
  * Standard Lengths: 2500 mm (2.5 m), 6300 mm (6.3 m), 12000 mm / 12500 mm (12 m / 12.5 m).
* **CTL / Coil Processing Limitations:**
  * Cut-to-length offered from mother coils (e.g., 3.6 m, 5 m, 6 m, 9 m, 10 m).
  * Light thickness coils (5 mm, 5.8 mm, 6 mm) when sheared at long lengths (e.g., 6.3 m) exhibit natural mild side-loose / edge waves (*"Thickness கம்மின்றதுனால side-ல லேசா வளைவு / side loose வரும்"* [Because thickness is light, slight side loose/edge waviness is natural]).

### 2. Chequered Plates
* **Thicknesses:** 4 mm, 5 mm, 6 mm (Standard 1250 x 2500 mm / 8x4 ft).
* **Make:** Primarily JSW.
* *Note:* 3 mm chequered plate is not available / not rolled regularly.

### 3. Structural Steel (Beams, Channels, Angles)
* **MS Channels (ISMC):** 100x50, 125x65, 150x75, 200x75, 250x82 mm.
  * *Market Constraint:* **75x40 mm channel** is facing prolonged rolling halt (3+ months) across primary mills (SAIL/Vizag).
* **Beams & Heavy Sections (NPB / Joists / WBP):**
  * NPB 200, 250, 300 (36 kg/m), 350 (50 kg/m & 57 kg/m), 400, 450, 600 NPB.
  * Heavy columns: WBP 300x300 (117 kg/m).
  * *Not handled:* NPB 240 / S355JR custom imported sections.
* **Equal Angles (ISA):** 50x50x6 (50 car), 65x65x6, 75x75x6, 90x90x8 (Vizag), 110x12 mm.
  * Sizes <50 mm (e.g., 40x6 mm) only available in commercial re-rolling, not SAIL/Vizag primary.

### 4. TMT Rebars & Miscellaneous
* **TMT Bars:** 10 mm, 12 mm (SAIL / Vizag / Jindal).
  * Supplied as **Straight Length (12 m)** requiring 40 ft trailers, or **U-Bend (Bent rods)** accommodating smaller open trucks/Eichers.
* **Square Bars:** 50x50 mm (rolling make).
* **Pipes / Hollow Sections:** RHS/SHS/Round pipes quoted against specific confirmed wholesale orders.
* **Decking Sheets / Roofing:** Diverted directly to sister concern **Crayon Roofing and Structures**.
